name: Pioneer Motor Public Company Limited
summary: Pioneer Motor Public Company Limited engages in the manufacturing and distribution of electric motors in Thailand. The company offers air-conditioning motors, industrial motors, dewatering and centrifugal pumps, motors for pools and spas, submersible pumps, and motor home pumps, as well as swimming pool pump motors. Pioneer Motor Public Company Limited was founded in 2001 and is based in Nakhon Pathom, Thailand.
